newsitem.title: USA: Titanium Metals workers ratify pact.
newsitem.headline: Titanium Metals workers ratify pact.

text.p: Titanium Metals Corp said hourly workers at its Henderson, Nev., plant voted to ratify a four-year labor agreement.
About 350 production and maintenance workers at the facility are represented by the United Steelworkers of America, the company said.
The new agreement runs until October 2, 2000, which is one year longer than the historical three-year agreement at the plant, the company said.

It said the contract provides for, among other things, increases in wages during each of the four years and enhancements in pension benefits over the course of the agreement, the costs of which are expected to be offset in part by an agreed-upon reduction in the level of profit sharing available to employees in certain years.
